HOSTING_REALISED_CODES.doc: What the console did with a plugin's verdict: hosting.realised.* and the outcomes with no dimension (hosting.disabled, hosting.unjudged, hosting.no-realisation, hosting.linked), read by code, never by prose.

disabled.doc: the console's in-process switch is off: an LV2 runs isolated, and a third-party CLAP, which has no other path, is refused

text.en: This plugin is disabled. Enable it before using it.

linked.doc: the plugin is one of the engine's statically linked CLAPs and runs in-process on the node that carries the CLAP bank

text.en: This plugin is realised linked into the host’s own process.

noRealisation.doc: the plugin earned a path that has no body here: no LV2 adapter or CLAP bank to run it, or a port class the stage cannot bind

text.en: This plugin has no realisation: nothing runs it. Give it a way to run before using it.

realisedInProcess.doc: the plugin runs in-process: it earned it and the console's switch allows it

text.en: This plugin is realised in its own process, isolated from the host’s.

unjudged.doc: the plugin has no verdict on record for this build (a linked CLAP without a row measured on the pinned build): it is refused at load

text.en: This plugin has not been judged yet. Judge it before trusting any verdict about it.
